practices.practice: Read the cluster connection string from an environment variable (DOCUMENTDB_URI) and do not commit credentials to source control or logs.

practices.practice: Make seed scripts idempotent: detect existing data and skip inserts (or support an overwrite flag) so seeding can be run safely multiple times.
practices.prior_belief: Seed scripts should be idempotent: detect existing collections/documents and either upsert or skip to avoid duplicating test data or corrupting a shared environment.

practices.practice: Create explicit indexes for fields used by queries (e.g., diagnoses, patient_id + visit_date) so aggregation and sort stages can use indexes.
practices.prior_belief: Create explicit indexes for the exact fields used by the care-gap aggregation and any common filter/sort patterns (e.g., patient_id, date_of_birth, diagnosis_codes, visit_date, last_visit_date) and prefer compound indexes matching query shapes.

practices.practice: Perform server-side aggregation (e.g., $sort then $group) to compute per-entity summary values (last visit) rather than pulling full result sets to the client.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid open-ended queries that return large result sets; push filtering and aggregation into server-side aggregation pipelines to reduce data transfer and memory usage on the client.

practices.practice: Sort by visit_date before grouping in an aggregation to compute the most-recent visit efficiently (use $sort then $group with $first).
